newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline steady after Shell refiner glitch.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline steady after Shell refiner glitch.

text.p: NWE gasoline prices were steady to slightly higher on Tuesday after trade sources said Shell's 370,000 barrel per day Rotterdam refinery experienced an unspecified technical problem that may last about a week.
"It had an impact in so much as (Shell) is not so long," and was not an aggressive seller in the barge market, broker said.
Eurograde barges ended $1 higher at $218/$220 fob ARA, after fluctuating as much as $2 higher and $1 lower with gyrations in crude and gasoline futures.
Trade sources could not give details on the impact to the refinery's production and a spokesman for the refinery was not able to comment immediately.
In the cargo market, prices ended unchanged at $222/$224 cif but traders said U.S. demand was still keeping local prices steady, though no deals were heard done today.
"The arb is open for certain people for certain things. It's rather woolly," said one trader who was looking to sell a cargo to the States. He described the NWE market as balanced.
